caption_L1: Here a is a line plot called Infant mortality rate in Singapore from 2005 to 2019 (per 1,000 live births). The x-axis shows Year with linear scale of range 2006 to 2018 while the y-axis plots Infant mortality rate per 1,000 live births on linear scale with a minimum of 0.0 and a maximum of 2.5.
caption_L2L3: Despite some kinks, the trend in infant mortality in Singapore is downwards. Infant mortality declined from about 2.1 per thousand live births in 2015 to about 1.7 per thousand in 2019. Infant mortality increased sharply in 2006 and 2016. Infant mortality was about 1.7 per thousand in 2015 and then again in 2019.
